text: This report provides an update for the Board on the 2022-2026 Strategic Plan ("Plan") development process. The Strategic Plan will outline the key priorities and delivery objectives over the next five years, emphasizing key actions as Exhibition Place begins reopening and recovery from the pandemic. Further, the Plan will advance the guidelines for development in the Board confirmed Master Plan recommendations.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Received the report (January 26, 2022) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place for information.
